At Ahzab the enemy kept the Prophet from the middle prayer, the afternoon prayer, till sunset, and he asked Allah to fill their houses and graves with fire.
At the Ditch Umar and the Prophet had both missed the afternoon prayer; the Prophet made ablution, prayed it after sunset, then prayed the evening prayer.
On a bitterly cold, windy night of Ahzab the Prophet sends Hudhaifa to bring news of the enemy without provoking them; he holds back from shooting Abu Sufyan and returns.
Carrying earth while digging the ditch, the Prophet chants verses with his companions, praying that, since true life is the Hereafter's, Allah forgive and help the Ansar and Muhajirs.
Aisha said the verse 'When they came upon you from above you and from below you' concerns the day of the Ditch.
